zh: 智能計算器新增「最低起投門檻 + 現有現金 + 每月新增資金 + 派息」完整模型。像「最低1.2萬才能購買，現金8萬，每月存4000，每年派息18%，6年後多少」可零追問直接計算真實買入節奏、累計派息、期末持倉、待投現金及期末月派息；派息率與資產／淨值增長分開處理，避免把 18% 派息錯當成本金 18% 複利。
投資結果預測升級為可變現金流模型，支援每年加供／減供、年化管理費／平台費及中途一次追加或提款。例如「現有20萬，每月投3000，第3年再加10萬，第6年拿走5萬」會按實際現金事件重新計算後續複利、累計投入、已提款、費用及淨收益。
新增三個常用智能場景：「每月提款可以用多久」「應急金要存多少、多久夠」「通脹後未來要多少才保持同等購買力」。提款模型可同時計入投資收益與生活費逐年增加；應急金會計算目標、差額及達標月份；通脹模型會顯示未來等值金額與購買力折損。
智能計算器新增「現金流／生活」示例分類，並加強多百分比自然語言消歧。同一句中的投資年化、管理費、派息率、通脹及提款增長會按語境分到正確欄位，不再互相污染。
儲蓄保險領取規劃與海報進一步重構：分段領取會顯示實際領取時間線與階段金額；反推模式會分開展示 100%／90%／80% 情景。一次性預繳現在只改變付款時點，未來年度保費不會被提前放入保單價值複利；預繳利息與折扣／回贈會作為保單外現金流獨立計算及展示。
完整 Flutter 回歸擴充至 141 項並全部通過；新增 390×844 手機零追問流程、隨機對抗輸入、派息頻率、費用、追加／提款、應急金及通脹專項回歸。Web Release 構建成功。
en: Added a complete minimum-purchase income-product model to Smart Calculator. Requests such as “minimum purchase 12k, 80k cash now, save 4k monthly, 18% annual income yield — how much after 6 years?” now resolve with no follow-up and model the actual purchase cadence, cumulative distributions, ending holdings, pending cash and ending monthly-income equivalent. Income yield is kept separate from NAV/asset growth so an 18% distribution rate is not misread as 18% capital appreciation.

Upgraded investment projection to support changing real-life cash flows: annual contribution step-ups/step-downs, annual management/platform fees, and one-off top-ups or withdrawals at specific years. Later compounding, contributed principal, withdrawals, fees and net gain are recalculated from the actual event timeline.

Added three everyday Smart scenarios: withdrawal longevity, emergency-fund planning, and future cost after inflation. Withdrawal longevity includes investment return and yearly spending growth; emergency planning calculates the reserve target, remaining gap and months to reach it; inflation planning shows the future equivalent amount and purchasing-power erosion.

Added a dedicated Cash flow / living-cost examples category and strengthened percentage disambiguation. Investment return, management fees, income yield, inflation and withdrawal growth can coexist in one sentence without contaminating each other.

Refined savings-insurance payout planning and posters. Tiered payouts now surface the actual timeline and staged amounts; reverse optimization separates 100%/90%/80% scenarios. One-time prepayment now changes payment timing only instead of prematurely compounding future premiums inside policy value, while prepayment interest and discounts/rebates are treated as separate off-policy cash flows.

Expanded the full Flutter regression suite to 141 passing tests, including 390×844 zero-follow-up mobile flows, randomized adversarial inputs, payout-frequency checks, fees, cash events, emergency funds and inflation. Web Release build succeeds.
